raw_segments.text: Romeo? Well, in that hit you miss. She'll not be hit with Cupid's arrow. She hath
Diane's wit, and in strong proof of chastity well-armed, from love's weak childish bow
she lives uncharmed. She will not stay the siege of loving terms nor bide tea-chink on
her of assailing eyes, nor ope her lap to saint-seducing gold. Oh, she's rich in beauty.
Only pour that when she dies, with beauty dies her store.
